tool_args.rationale: The pilot already covers the target horizon of 0.46; the uncertainty is in separating fast memory relaxation from coupling and slow decay. The fine trajectory batch adds transient evidence and raises the training count to at least eight before fitting the five-parameter ODE.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE to the pilot now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly constrain the fast memory timescale: all horizons are 7.6–10.4 times the characteristic scale, and u_past is proportional to u_now throughout the pilot.
Neither snapshot model accounts for the observed sink-gradient and coupled-memory signatures.
It is not offered, and the pilot already spans 1.95 in s_grad without flagged collinearity.
Its lower price does not resolve the coupled-transient ambiguity.
